content.text: {"cards":{"opening.3c76267fd4a5":["Ada wanted to invite Mira to Frog’s pond concert, and Ben wanted to help. But the pond was still, Mira wanted quiet, and nobody yet knew what sort of concert would fit. The painted invitation waited in Ada’s garden beside Frog’s drum."],"scene.wish_news.notice.e72ce7a203a6":["Ada peeked toward Mira’s porch and noticed Mira sitting with a book, enjoying quiet. “Quiet,” Ada whispered, “is Mira’s wish today.”"],"scene.move_drum.220ddbef629f":["Frog carried his acorn drum from the garden to the pond. He set it near the water, where its round wooden belly was ready to go bonk—or perhaps merely bonk politely."],"scene.wish_news.share.d2b81372e3fc":["Ada told Frog, “Mira wants quiet today.” Frog nodded. “Then my drum shall use its teeny-tiniest toes.”"],"scene.move_invitation.46cdaa97a7fd":["Ada picked up the painted invitation and carried it from the garden to the porch. She held it carefully; the blue frog on its front had very important-looking spots."],"scene.quiet_performance.046793c60398":["Knowing Mira wanted quiet, Frog played a gentle song on the acorn drum. Tap, hush, tap—each note skimmed the pond like a tiny pebble that had learned manners."],"scene.walk_to_porch.7180d07384b0":["With the invitation waiting on the porch, Ada walked up from the garden. She practiced her polite knock, then decided one knock was plenty."],"scene.deliver_invitation.4aec9a7c1653":["Ada gave Mira the painted invitation. “A pond concert,” she said, “with a very small volume knob.” Mira accepted it from Ada with a curious smile."],"scene.quiet_response.0a677dda4645":["Mira smiled and listened to Frog’s gentle pond song. She stayed on the porch, quiet as a sleeping feather, while the soft taps reached her."],"scene.mark_delivery.b9549d0d5023":["The invitation was safely delivered: Mira now owned the painted card, and Ada’s delivery was complete. The blue frog on the card seemed pleased with its new address."],"ending.8608fb54269f":["Mira smiled and listened as Frog’s gentle notes floated across the still pond. Ada’s invitation rested safely in Mira’s hands, and the acorn drum made no thunder at all. In the evening light, each quiet ripple looked like a little silver ear, listening too."],"opening.bd90405582b0":["Ada planned to invite Mira to Frog’s pond concert, while Ben hoped to help. Mira wanted to join, but the pond was perfectly still and the concert tools were scattered in the garden. Ada’s painted invitation waited beside a wide lily pad, as if both were awaiting instructions."],"scene.wish_news.notice.d5b5c2dbc2b2":["Ada watched Mira on the porch, where Mira leaned forward as though eager for music. “She wants to join,” Ada observed. “That is wonderfully less quiet than a potato.”"],"scene.wish_news.share.7b8f05862c31":["Ada told Frog that Mira wanted to join the concert. Frog puffed up happily. “Excellent! I know three rhythms and one accidental sneeze.”"],"scene.move_lily_pad.67de175dae06":["Ada pushed her wide lily pad from the garden onto the pond. It floated broad and steady, making a perfect little platform for Frog’s planned rhythm."],"scene.lively_still_performance.67a277561cfa":["Frog began a lively rhythm on the lily pad. The still pond let every plip and plop travel outward, while the pad bobbed like a cheerful green drumhead."],"scene.joining_response.684183e91716":["Mira joined the lively pond rhythm from the porch, tapping along with her fingers. Her smile arrived on the beat, though her left thumb was slightly ahead of everyone."],"scene.deliver_invitation.521a69f462ae":["Ada gave Mira the painted invitation. “You’re invited to join Frog’s concert,” Ada said. Mira accepted the card, already listening for the next beat."],"ending.591325c26843":["Mira joined Frog’s lively rhythm while Ada watched from the porch, and the invitation stayed safely with its new owner. The still pond carried the music in bright circles; even the lily pad seemed to bounce, as if it had swallowed a very polite trampoline."],"opening.c6cd456bbbb4":["Ada wanted to invite Mira to Frog’s pond concert, and Ben wanted to help. Yet Mira wanted quiet while a breeze skimmed the pond, and Ada’s wide lily pad still waited in the garden. Frog’s acorn drum waited too, although it belonged to Frog and not to Ada."],"scene.wind_news.notice.bf86fdeb564c":["Frog noticed a breeze ruffling the pond. “The water is tickling the reeds,” he said. “A lily pad might go sailing without buying a ticket.”"],"scene.wind_news.share.87c3353cec8e":["Frog told Ada about the breezy pond. Ada looked at the waving reeds and nodded. “Then we’ll give my lily pad something sturdy to hold.”"],"scene.secure_breezy_pad.5f6862130dff":["Ada and Ben anchored the lily pad against the breeze. Ben held the cord while Ada pressed the anchor down; the pad stopped drifting and stayed put."],"ending.eaab006677c4":["Mira smiled and listened to Frog’s gentle song while the anchored lily pad held steady in the breezy pond. Ben’s helping hands had made a difference, and Ada’s invitation rested with Mira. Across the water, soft notes trembled like tiny lanterns tied safely to their strings."],"opening.30afe05c374d":["Ada hoped to invite Mira to Frog’s pond concert, and Ben hoped to help. Mira wanted to join, but a breeze teased the pond and the wide lily pad was still in the garden. Frog’s drum waited there too, stubbornly refusing to teleport."],"scene.lively_breezy_performance.d0737d95f74d":["With the lily pad anchored against the breeze, Frog turned it into a lively rhythm. His drumbeat and the pad’s gentle thump made a bouncy, dependable pulse."],"ending.7d92d4195fb5":["Mira joined the lively rhythm as Frog played his anchored lily-pad beat. The breeze whisked over the water, but the pad stayed steady, and Ada’s invitation remained safely with Mira. Sunlight flashed on the ripples while Ben grinned beside the anchor, right on the beat."]}}
